title: Minimal owner-drawn Programmable Stitch Creator patterns (2-point line, 4-point square, two lines, motifs, decorative) and the PES designs that use them
description: Six pattern sources drawn in PE-DESIGN 11.50's Programmable Stitch Creator with known grid coordinates (compat/reference/pes/psc-*.pas, .pmf, .plf): a 2-point diagonal line, a closed 4-point square (written with its closing point), two separate lines (a jump), the untouched 2-point motif, a 3-point zigzag motif, and a decorative-fill line. Four designs use them: programmable fill with the square and with the line, motif fill with the 2-point motif, and a 40 mm line with the zigzag motif; each is read by OpenStitch and written again (stitches and colours survive). Issues #130, #131 (the ASCII grammar: @VERSION 10000; @SYSENV 1 for .pas/.pmf, @SYSENV 10000 10000 1 for .plf; @TILE n + @TILELINE i npts x y ...; @LINE npts x y ...; cell 0..1024) and #134's request for owner-made container samples (fonts were not recordable: Font Creator access was declined).

evidence.note: compat/reference/pes/psc-*.pas/.pmf/.plf (Programmable Stitch Creator 11.50, 2026-10-29): psc-line-2pt.pas: Fill/Stamp: one line from the cell's top-left to its bottom-right corner (@TILELINE 0 2 0 0 1024 1024); psc-square-4pt.pas: Fill/Stamp: a closed square, clicks (128,128) (896,128) (896,896) (128,896) and a double-click back on (128,128); PE-DESIGN writes the closing point, 5 points; psc-two-lines.pas: Fill/Stamp: two separate horizontal lines at y 256 and 768 (@TILE 2, two @TILELINE records; nothing marks the jump); psc-motif-2pt.pmf: Motif: the editor's fixed base line (0,512)-(1024,512) saved untouched (@LINE 2); psc-motif-zigzag-3pt.pmf: Motif: a point added by clicking the base line and dragged to (512,768) (@LINE 3); psc-deco-1line.plf: Decorative Fill: one line (128,128)-(896,896) on the 16 x 16 grid (@SYSENV 10000 10000 1, @TILE 1, @TILELINE 0 2)
